crossRefs.note: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

parallels.note: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

people.name: Jobab
people.line: A king of Edom, son of Zerah of Bozrah

people.name: Teman
people.line: Grandson of Esau, associated with an Edomite clan

translations.web: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
translations.bsb: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
translations.kjv: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.
translations.asv: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.
